results.title: India.gov.in | National Portal India: Where Government Information Converges
results.description: The National Portal of India provides single-window access to information and services offered by the government at all levels. It focuses on unifying information collated from platforms and portals, packaged and served based on user segments such as farmers, students, women, youth, etc., as well as sectoral views. The portal is built using the latest technology, featuring a user-friendly, multilingual, accessible, and contemporary interface with intuitive navigation and information architecture.
